text_markup: The symbol [MU] (plaintext: {curly:MU}) stands for "memory" and also represents the unit used to measure memory. When used with a quantity, it should be read as "memory units". For example, 2[MU] means "2 memory units." See {ref:sec_memory} for rules about memory.
text_plain: The symbol {MU} (plaintext: {MU}) stands for "memory" and also represents the unit used to measure memory. When used with a quantity, it should be read as "memory units". For example, 2{MU} means "2 memory units." See section 1.20 for rules about memory.
